author: Linsor
quote:
The story revolves around a relationship you have to take care of in a realistic way, even though it's toxic and the guy is a simp. I'm married irl, I don't want to be putting up dry wall and taking care of a digital woman's period. I come to play games after I do that for my actual woman and house.

It makes it a really uncomfortable experience, like what happened to the psychotic crime ridden gangsters I used to play as?? Now I'm some random guy in a toxic ass relationship I never had the choice to be a part of, and to the people saying it's side content having to take care of her, it effects the story!
